next_steps: The task's deliverable already exists and is committed (see report). Recommend closing task 380 citing commit 7ffb39166 as evidence rather than running /plan 380 to author a no-op plan; if a plan phase runs anyway, it should be a single trivial verification-only phase.

memory_candidates.content: A task's required fix can land in the repo as a side effect of an unrelated task's dispatch (observed: task 380's archival-mv warning was committed under task 296's .return-meta.json accounting) without the original task being marked resolved. Before dispatching a plan/implement phase for any task, check `git log -- <file_scope paths>` for a commit already satisfying the description -- a cheap check that avoids a duplicate no-op edit and lets the task close on existing evidence instead.
